Customers Requiring Proactive Attention

Ranked by a risk score weighting each ticket's most severe open finding (Breach > Data Gap > At Risk/Action Required), normalized per ticket so busy and quiet accounts are compared fairly. Needs Attention / Watch / Healthy split the current account population into thirds by that score — relative standing this run, not a fixed pass/fail line.

Engineer Performance Score

Transparent weighted blend: 35% SLA Compliance + 20% Delegation Compliance + 35% Resolution Volume (relative to peers) + 10% CSAT (avg rating + survey collection rate). This weighting is a management judgment call, stated explicitly rather than hidden — see Notes & Exclusions.

Color & Threshold Reference

The exact cut-offs the dashboard uses to color every KPI card, pill, and gauge red / amber / green.

MetricGreen — Met / Not ViolatedAmber — WarningRed — Violated / Missed
SLA Compliance % (Classification / Resolution / First Response / Overall)≥ 90%75% – 89%< 75%
Effort Utilization % (Consumed ÷ Allocated)≤ 80%81% – 95%> 95%
Escalation Rate %≤ 10%11% – 20%> 20%
Customer Health Score (0–100)≥ 75 · Good50 – 74 · Watch< 50 · At Risk
Engineer Performance Score (0–100)≥ 75 · Top Performer50 – 74 · On Track< 50 · Needs Support
Average Customer Rating (out of 5)≥ 4.03.0 – 3.9< 3.0

  Open Ticket Age (Aging Analysis) uses a four-step freshness scale rather than a violation scale: 0–3 days green, 4–7 days informational blue, 8–30 days amber, 30+ days red.

Managed Services Governance Dashboard — Executive Summary, Customer Dashboard, Engineer Dashboard, SLA Dashboard, Support & Ticket Analytics, Resource Utilization, Knowledge Base, Escalation Analysis, Aging Analysis, and Delegation & Ownership Governance (L1/L2/SME ownership lifecycle, delegation SLA, ticket journeys), all computed live in your browser from the report you upload. Nothing is transmitted anywhere: parsing, scoring, charting and Excel export all run locally, so the file works completely offline once the page and its CDN assets have loaded.
